"""Simulate a verifier invocation: 8 mixed lines, one JSON object per line."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

lines = [
    '{"services":["PUBLIC","api","auth","db"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["PUBLIC","api","auth","db"]}}],"queries":[[],["PUBLIC","api"]]}',
    '{"services":["a","aa","β"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"startswith","path":["a"]}},{"action":"drop","when":{"op":"contains","path":["aa"]}}],"queries":[["a","β","a"],["a","aa"]]}',
    '{"services":[],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"endswith","path":[]}}],"queries":[[]]}',
    '{"services":["x"],"rules":[],"queries":[["unknown"]]}',
    '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"x":NaN}',
    'not json at all',
    '{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true"}}],"queries":[["a"],["a","a"]]}',
    '{"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"and","args":[]}}],"queries":[]}',
]
payload = ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                   capture_output=True, timeout=60)
print("rc:", p.returncode, "stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:200])
out = p.stdout.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
print("output lines:", len(out), "(expected 8)")
for i, line in enumerate(out):
    obj = json.loads(line)
    print(i, json.dumps(obj)[:110])
